title: WATCH How God Will Go Before You To Fight Your Battles (Daily Jesus Devotional)
paragraphs: in the vast expanse of a night sky each twinkling star reminds us of the infinite possibilities that lie ahead as daunting as life's challenges can be there is peace in knowing that there's a Guiding Light waiting to lead us through our darkest moment just as the shepherd leads his flock through treacherous terrains under the guidance of the North Star God desires to lead us through our battles to Champion our causes and to ensure that we never face our adversaries alone today

we're also going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God to go before you to win your battles and to bless you abundantly in the name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer now when one thinks of a Vanguard images of Warriors leading the charge scouting ahead and ensuring the path is clear come to mind God is the ultimate Vanguard as Psalm 121: 1-2 says I lift up my

eyes to the hills from whence comes my help my help comes from the Lord who made Heaven and Earth this omnipotent omnipresent God desires to lead our charge always ensuring we are protected and guided just like the Israelites who were led by a cloud during the day and a pillar of Fire by Night God's guidance is ever present in our lives as we we tread the path of life we must have faith that God is ahead of us scouting the terrain

and preparing the best way forward the act of God going before us is not just metaphorical it's a profound reality that is rooted in Biblical history remember when the Israelites were up against fortified cities and colossal armies in their conquest of Canaan the battles they faced seemed insurmountable by human standards yet God gave them Victory after Victory an unusual story in this regard is when the Lord set ambushes against the enemies of Judah and they were defeated found in 2 Chronicles

20:22 here the people of Judah only needed to stand firm hold their position and see God's Deliverance they didn't have to fight they had to believe and let God act on their behalf my friends Hold Your Position in God and allow God to fight on your behalf now promises play an integral role in our spiritual Journey they are like anchors that keep our faith steady amidst turbulent seas and of all the promises none is more comforting than the one where God

assures us of his constant presence as he himself declared in Deuteronomy 31:8 and the Lord he is the one who goes before you he will be with you he will not leave you nor forsake you do not fear nor be dis made my friends this declaration coming directly from the Creator is powerful Beyond Comprehension This Promise is reiterated throughout scripture God's commitment to his people is evident in his actions and his words are not just Hollow Comforts in the times of

the Israelites when faced with threats from enemy Nations or challenges like hunger and thirst in the wilderness God's promise always stood firm consider the Lesser quoted tale of Hezekiah who when threatened by the Assyrian King senb turned to God Hezekiah received the Lord's Assurance through the prophet Isaiah that the Assyrians would not enter Jerusalem nor shoot an arrow there true to his word god defended the city and sent an angel to strike down the Assyrian army as written in 2 Kings

19 the world often instructs us to take control to fight fiercely and to let our presence be known but the kingdom of God operates differently here Faith Reigns Supreme our greatest asset isn't our strength or intelligence but our unwavering faith in God's power Psalm 27:1 proclaims the Lord is my light and my salvation Whom Shall I Fear the Lord is the strength of my life of whom shall I be afraid in these words King David the shepherd turned King acknowledges the

profound peace that comes from TR trusting God our world is filled with challenges that can easily induce fear economic downturns health issues relationship problems and so much more yet when fear knocks Faith must answer a lesser-known instance of this is found in the story of King ASA of Judah when Zer the Ethiopian came out against him with an army of a million men ASA cried out to the Lord in 2 Chronicles 14:1 acknowledging that is not by might nor by power

but by faith in God that victories are won the result God defeated the Ethiopians before ASA and Judah this story is a reminder that God is faithful to fight our battles my friends control is an illusion the more we clutch onto it the more it seems to slip away the real strength lies in surrender in laying down our arms and letting God lead the way way in Matthew 6:10 Jesus in teaching us how to pray included the words your will be

done on Earth as it is in heaven this profound truth is a call to realign our desires and plans with God's Sovereign will throughout Biblical history those who relinquished control and yielded to God witnessed profound miracles in 2 Kings 5 take for example the Lesser known story of non the Syrian Army Commander tricken with Leprosy and desperate for healing he was instructed by the prophet Elisha to wash in the Jordan River seven times initially resistant he was likely seeking more elaborate

rituals non and eventually surrendered control obeyed the simple instruction and was healed his healing came when he chose to let go and let God my friends ask yourself am I holding on to something that could be blocking my blessings when faced with overwhelming odds remember the battle is not yours but God's time and again when his people were up against insurmountable challenges God declared in 2 Chronicles 20:15 do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude for the battle

is not yours but God's this Proclamation delivered by jhazel reassured King Jehoshaphat and the people of Judah when they faced a massive Alliance of enemy Nations recalling a story that's not often in the Limelight we remember Jonathan King Saul's son with just his armor Bearer he decided to confront the Philistine Garrison his reason he declared for nothing restrains the Lord from saving by many or by few this story is found in 1st Samuel 14:6 with unyielding faith that the battle was

the Lord's Jonathan witnessed a resounding Victory proving that with God numbers don't matter my dear friends Success is Not defined by our strength or strategies but by God's intervention let God fight for you as we reflect upon these profound truths let's reaffirm our commitment to let God lead us letting God fight for us and trusting him with every Challenge and obstacle let's embrace the assurance that he has ever present ever willing and ever capable of ensuring Victory and as the Stars

light up the night sky May our faith illuminate our path always reminding us that God has already charted our course and won our battles praise God in the thick of challenging times finding calm can seem impossible but imagine being in a safe cozy house while a wild storm rages outside the house Shields and protects keeping those inside safe and dry this house is like the peace God offers us even when troubles are all around we can feel calm and protected knowing

God is with us the Bible tells us in Isaiah 26:3 you will keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you because he trusts in you this means that when we keep our thoughts on God and trust him he gives us a peace that's hard to understand my friend ends the peace that God gives it's like that cozy house in the storm now God doesn't just promise peace he gives it think about Jesus's friends the disciples one day they

were in a boat and a huge storm came waves were crashing into the boat and they were scared but Jesus he was asleep when they woke him up he just spoke to the storm and told it to be still and the storm listened the story in Mark 4:37 7 to39 shows us that with Jesus we can be calm even when things are crazy outside we can trust him to handle the storms of life my friends let Jesus still the storms in

your life yes we all face different storms problems at work disagreements with friends marriage problems Health troubles and much more but the good news is we don't have to face them alone by trusting in God we can find peace even when things look bad remember God is like that safe house and with him we can always feel protected picture a boat with many ores if all the ores are rowing in the same direction the boat moves smoothly but if one ore

goes a different way things get tricky this is like our relationship with God when we move in the same direction as him our journey is smoother but when we go our own way things get harder the Bible says Proverbs 3 verse 5-6 trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding in all your ways acknowledge Him and He Shall direct your paths this means we should trust God seek his way in everything and he'll guide

us in the Bible in Jonah chapter 1 there's a story of a man named Jonah God told him to go to a city called Nineveh but Jonah didn't want to instead he ran away in a ship but running from God didn't work out a big storm hit and Jonah ended up in the belly of a huge fish it was only when Jonah decided to do things God's way that he was saved this story teaches us that it's always better to follow

God's plans when we align or match our desires and actions with God's will we're like that boat with all ores moving together we can avoid many troubles and feel more at peace so in everything let's ask God what do you want me to do then say let's do it now sometimes when we look at an artwork up close or we see our colors and shapes it's only when we step back that we see the whole picture life is like that too

sometimes in the moment we can't see why things are happening but when we look back later we see how God was working in our lives the Bible tells us in Romans 8:28 and we know that all things work together for good to those who love God to those who are the called according to his purpose this means God is always making things work out for the best even when we don't see it right away this is a great reassurance of how

much God cares there's a story in the Bible in Genesis 41 about a man named Joseph his brothers were jealous and sold him as a slave Joseph faced many tough times like being thrown in jail for something he didn't do but later he became a powerful leader in Egypt and saved many people from Hunger when he looked back Joseph saw that God used all the bad times for good God was fighting his battles Joseph told his brothers in Genesis 50:20 Joseph

said you meant evil against me but God meant it for good yes at some point in our lives we all face tough times but when we look back we often see how God used those moments for something good maybe a hard situation made us stronger taught us something or brought us closer to someone so even when we don't understand what's happening let's trust that God has a good plan one day you'll look back and see the beautiful picture he was creating

with your lives imagine a train on a set of tracks the tracks are designed to lead the train to its destination safely efficiently and with purpose when the train remains on its tracks it moves forward encountering few obstacles and smoothly progressing toward its destination however if the train were to attempt to move off its tracks Not only would it fail to reach its destination but it could also cause harm to itself others close by and also its surroundings similarly our life's

journey is most fruitful and purposeful when we align ourselves with God's will I urge you stay on God's track and let him go before you and fight your battles now remember the story of the Israelites wandering in the desert they were promised the land of Canaan a land flowing with milk and honey yet because of their disobedience their reluctance to trust God's plan what should have been an 11-day Journey turned into 40 Years of wandering they kept veering off the path

God set for them doubting his promises and even longing for the chains of Egypt over the freedom God offered their hesitation to align their desires and actions with God's will led to a necessary hardship when we try to navigate life without adhering to the tracks God has laid out for us we can become lost face unnecessary AR challenges and miss out on the blessings he has in store just like a train is designed to run best on its tracks we are

designed to flourish when we align ourselves with God's Will by seeking his guidance in every decision and stepping in faith we ensure a smoother and more fulfilling journey in every situation we should pause and seek his voice asking God what is your plan in this by following his lead we ensure we are on the right track moving closer to the purpose and Destiny he has for us my friends this is how you get God to fight your battles again life has

a way of surprising us just like watching a film where a Twist at the end makes us see the entire story differently in the same way life can often turn in ways that later make us realize the larger narrative God had in store these unexpected turns may be confusing or even disheartening in the moment but with time their purpose becomes clear my dear friends trust God today and win your battles tomorrow now consider Esther a young Jewish girl who unexpectedly became

the queen of Persia at the outset her life seemed to be one of luxury and favor far removed from the struggles of her people yet behind the palace walls a plot was brewing to destroy the Jews morai Esther's cousin alerted her of this and urged her to intervene with the King even though it could mean her death in this tense moment morai spoke words that might have given Esther a glimpse into God's bigger plan in Esther 4:14 he said who knows

whether you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this besta took a brave step relying on her faith and approached the king the result Not only was the plot against the Jews thwarted but her people were also honored and protected in the midst of the story Esther might have wondered why she a simple Jewish girl was placed in the palace but in hindsight it became clear she was strategically positioned by God to save her people in the story

we see God going before and winning the battle for his people story of Esther is a vivid reminder for us when we are in the thick of challenges it might seem like our life is off course that our struggles have no meaning but if we pause and reflect we often find that the dots connect in ways we hadn't imagined those times of hardship of waiting of uncertainty were often the very platforms that propelled us into our purpose so whenever we Face

situations that don't immediately make sense let's remember eser and take comfort in the fact that our current chapter is just a piece of a much larger Divine narrative God is always weaving our stories with intention and love and in his perfect timing he will reveal the Masterpiece he's been crafting all along my friends fear not only believe trust God and keep on his track allow him to go before and win the battles that you could not now to all those within

the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to a gracious and loving God Lord Almighty maker of heaven and Earth I stand in awe of your infinite power and love you who laid the foundations of the universe are the same God who knows the depths of my heart father I come before you acknowledging my

trespasses my shortcoming and the times I have tried to fight battles on my own forgive me for not always relying on your strength and for sometimes letting my fear overshadow my faith today I reaffirm my trust in you to win my battles in the mighty name of Jesus I declare victory over the battles I face I rebuke any Force visible or invisible that stands against your will and purpose for My Life by The Authority given to me as as a Believer

I cast out any Spirit of Doubt fear and confusion I command them to leave never to return father I pray that my heart be filled with unwavering Faith even in times of uncertainty trusting that you will go before me fighting my battles Lord I ask for your Shield of protection around me and my loved ones keep us safe from harm protect our health and bless us abundantly as I lay down my fears replace them with faith knowing that in every challenge

every situation you are there with us let your peace which surpasses understanding be upon my family my friends and everyone dear to me grant them the assurance that you are fighting for them and may they always find refuge in your unchanging love as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I pray that each one of us experience is a renewed strength in our Spirits may we all stand firm in the promises of your word acknowledging that you are our Mighty

Fortress and deliverer I pray that as we Face the days ahead our hearts will overflow with gratitude recognizing the countless times you have fought for us clearing paths and turning battles into blessings Lord let our lives be a testament to your unending love and Power may we walk in your grace love fearlessly and serve you wholeheartedly now and always in Jesus precious name I pray heyen if you were blessed by this message type the word Heyman in the comment section below

you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comment section so that we can present them before God for your blessings

and victory and we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that we did not pray for you rest assured we are actively lifting

up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
